name: expiry-food-marketplace
description: Full-stack marketplace web application for rescuing near-expiry food at discounted prices

scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../customer-app && npm install && cd ../store-app && npm install && cd ../admin-app && npm install && cd ..
scripts.render-build: cd backend && npm install && cd ../customer-app && npm install --include=dev && npm run build && cd ../store-app && npm install --include=dev && npm run build && cd ../admin-app && npm install --include=dev && npm run build && cd ..
scripts.build:all: npm run build:customer && npm run build:store && npm run build:admin
